title: لعبة Modern Warfare 4 لن تصل إلى Game Pass عند إطلاقها

sources.name: Call of Duty blog, COD Intel (Modern Warfare 4 launch and Xbox Game Pass)
Xbox Wire, Modern Warfare 4 Launches October 23 as a Standalone Release

claims.text: MW4 launches as a standalone release; players must purchase it separately to play at launch
Not included with Game Pass until Holiday 2027
Black Ops 7, Black Ops 6 and MWIII stay on Game Pass Ultimate
Launch 23 Oct; campaign early access 16 Oct, DMZ early access 20 Oct for digital pre-orders
claims.source: Call of Duty blog (known since 10 Oct)
